description: This file defines the EditReminderDialog class, a UI component for creating and editing reminders in an Android app. It manages user interactions for setting reminder details, date, and time, and handles notification permissions.

classes.name: EditReminderDialog
classes.description: A dialog class for editing or creating reminders, handling user input for reminder details, date, and time, and managing notification permissions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, retrieves reminder and note ID from arguments.

methods.name: createBinding
methods.description: Creates and inflates the dialog's view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the dialog UI, populates fields if editing an existing reminder, and requests notification permissions if needed.

methods.name: setupListeners
methods.description: Configures click listeners for date and time pickers and save button, handling reminder validation and saving.
